reglas: Una sola fuente sonora por indicación; las capas se mezclan después.
Todo en el mismo mundo: plastilina y madera, micrófono cercano, estudio seco (la sala la pone la mezcla).
Duración fijada por sonido; los ambientes se generan como bucle continuo.
Fidelidad a la indicación (prompt_influence) 0,5 en golpes y 0,4 en ambientes.

01.indicacion: Soft lump of modeling clay dropped onto a wooden table, dull squishy thud, close-mic, dry studio

02.indicacion: Thick plasticine bubble bursting, juicy wet pop with a soft squelch tail, close-mic, dry studio

03.indicacion: Small rubbery clay ball bouncing once on a wooden table, soft springy boing, close-mic, dry studio

04.indicacion: Soft ball of modeling clay rolling slowly across a wooden tabletop, gentle continuous rumble with tiny sticky clicks, close-mic

05.indicacion: Soft modeling clay being slowly stretched, rubbery elastic squeak rising in pitch, close-mic, dry studio

06.indicacion: Fingernail scratching slowly across firm modeling clay, gritty dragging scrape, close-mic, dry studio

07.indicacion: Dry hardened clay piece snapping in half, crisp brittle crack followed by small crumbs falling on wood, close-mic

08.indicacion: Gentle steady rain pattering on a small wooden model set, soft and intimate, close perspective

09.indicacion: Soft airy breeze with a faint gentle whistle, calm and steady

10.indicacion: Quiet cozy science lab room tone, faint soft electrical hum, very calm

11.indicacion: Short soft airy whoosh, quick and playful, smooth swell and fade

12.indicacion: Magical shrinking zoom effect, rising sparkly shimmer with a soft whoosh, bright and playful
